mentions.name: VS Code Agent Kanban
mentions.description: A VS Code extension that implements a Kanban board backed by markdown files. It enables communicating with GitHub Copilot chat through markdown files so considerations, decisions and actions leave a clear permanent record, and adds visual organization plus shortcut commands to make managing the markdown files easier than the author's previous manual workflow.
mentions.problem: The author's similar but more manual markdown-based workflow worked well but was harder to manage; this extension simplifies managing the markdown files and adds visual organization with shortcut commands.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's a VS Code extension that implements a Kanban board backed by markdown files. It's set up to allow you to communicate with GitHub Copilot chat via markdown files, so you have a clear permanent record of your considerations, decisions and actions. I'd been getting great results with a similar but more manual workflow, so I built this to make managing the markdown files easier and to give me the ability to visually organise with some shortcut commands.
